encounters.enemies: 2 enemies in one wave: the Consecrated Red Vulture and Consecrated Scorpion.
encounters.res:
Consecrated Red Vulture: Consecrated Enhance: Physical, Hydro, Electro, Cryo, Dendro, Anemo, Geo 40%; Pyro 70%.
Consecrated Scorpion: Consecrated Enhance: Physical, Pyro, Hydro, Cryo, Dendro, Anemo, Geo 40%; Electro 70%.
encounters.req: Clear: defeat all opponents. | Star Challenge: finish within 1m 5s.
encounters.mech: Energy Blocks: After their special attacks, a Beast can release a block lasting 6s. The Scorpion's takes one Electro hit or six other elemental hits; the Vulture's takes one Pyro hit or six other elemental hits. Without a Pyro character, use repeated elemental hits for the Vulture. Counterattack: Breaking a block grants energy for 10s. Hit the corresponding Beast before it expires to consume it, deal 15% of the Beast's Max HP as damage, and paralyze it for roughly 10s. Holding the energy causes party HP loss, so use it promptly. Resistance Change: The Beast exits its enhanced form during the mechanic and returns to it if the block or absorbed energy is not used in time. Its Freeze resistance makes Freeze less reliable for stopping its attacks.

encounters.name: Normal · Wilderness Hunter
encounters.enemies: 1 enemy in one wave: Wilderness Hunter.
encounters.req: Clear: defeat all opponents. | Star Challenge: finish within 1m 35s.
encounters.mech: Maximum HP Bar: The gray section filling from the right shows how much maximum HP has been removed. The Hunter is only defeated when its maximum HP reaches zero. Grief-Stricken: Its body turns gray, making this state visually recognizable. Depleting ordinary HP triggers this state for 10s instead of defeating it. Damage during this window reduces maximum HP. Ascendant Gleam: Bring at least two Moonsign characters to enable Ascendant Gleam. An ability enhanced by Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam can trigger Grief-Stricken early. During Grief-Stricken, 65% of damage taken reduces its maximum HP; Ascendant Gleam increases this to 90%. Reserve your strongest damage for these windows. Recovery: After a normal HP-depletion window, it can recover to its remaining maximum HP. During an early Gleam-triggered window it can still attack.

Avoid the Mark: Use invincibility frames (i-frames) to avoid the debuff on your active character. They then need no healing to clear it, but cannot gain the buff awarded for clearing it through healing. Alternatively, bait the Moonfly away from the center, then run to the opposite side of the arena to stay outside the attack's range and avoid the debuff entirely. Clearing the mark removes its penalties and grants 15% CRIT Rate and 50% Damage Bonus for 15s. Attack Cycle: It alternates Dendro and Pyro attack sequences, then releases an arena-wide blast before 15s of exhaustion. Use healing to recover your damage output while avoiding its projectiles and blasts.
